scope: Source-supported qualitative L1-L4 facade glazing refinement only. No placement, roof/L5, circulation, entrance, GIS footprint, or master edits.

source.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections, Historic Facilities and Buildings Database
source.feature_id: Database building record 75; Maurice G. Knoy Hall of Technology
source.measurement_method: Qualitative visual review only. Several visible faces show narrow horizontal glazing ribbons framed by deeper brick areas. The image is perspective and has no scale/camera calibration; no pixel-to-meter measurement was attempted.
source.supports: Narrower ribbon-window proportion and brick infill above/below the ribbons on visible elevations.
source.does_not_support: Exact window height, sill/head elevation, bay spacing, material specification, all-sided facade assignment, or as-built elevations.

geometry_changes.vertical_registration: Each ribbon remains centered on its prior band center; no story datum was moved.
geometry_changes.infill: Solid 0.30 m upper/lower strips at each L1-L4 window envelope, using the existing red-brick material.

uncertainty: The 1.40 m ribbon height is an explicitly estimated visual proportion, not an as-built measurement. The whole-building facade cadence remains unverified; the photograph is partial and perspective.
